executiveSummary.headline: Strong AI Visibility, With Opportunities to Improve Digital Accuracy and Control
executiveSummary.lead: Spice Island Beach Resort is well positioned in the AI travel searches monitored by Dealality, ranking first among its certified competitive group. This provides a strong foundation as more travelers turn to AI when researching hotels and destinations.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: These metrics describe presence in monitored AI answers—not booking conversion or traveler exposure.

themes.title: Hotel Information Accuracy
themes.what: Official dining structured data claims a Michelin Star for Oliver Restaurant. Michelin confirms One MICHELIN Key for the resort. A Key is not a restaurant Star — verify Star status independently before correcting award language.
themes.whyItMatters: Award language should match independently verified Michelin status. Treating a hotel Key as proof that a restaurant Star is false can produce an incorrect correction.

themes.title: Digital Presence and Information Control
themes.what: An independently operated booking site uses a domain similar to the official website, and a staging hostname appeared in limited AI citations. Some automated requests to the official site were blocked in research testing.
themes.whyItMatters: Confirm which sites represent the resort and whether intended search and AI systems can reach official content before changing access settings.

themes.title: Selective Commercial Opportunities
themes.what: There is no guest-facing official page for intimate executive retreats or exclusive gatherings—only a post-stay conference feedback form.
themes.whyItMatters: Clearer presentation could attract appropriately sized inquiries if management wants that demand. Pursue only if commercially attractive.

actions.headline: Verify Michelin Star Status for Oliver Restaurant Before Correcting Award Language
actions.priorityWhy: Public, specific claim that conflicts with Michelin’s published hotel recognition.
actions.whatWeFound: Official dining content claims a Michelin Star for Oliver Restaurant. Michelin Guide evidence confirms a MICHELIN Key for the hotel. A hotel Key is a different award from a restaurant Star and does not by itself prove the Star claim is false. No independent Michelin restaurant-Star listing for Oliver Restaurant was verified in this research pass.
actions.whyItMatters: Publishing unverified Star language creates reputation risk if guests or partners check Michelin. Confirming Star status before editing protects accuracy without treating Key recognition as Star disproof.
recommendedSteps: Check Michelin Guide restaurant listings for Oliver Restaurant independently of the hotel Key page.
Ask hotel leadership to confirm current Star and Key status in writing.
If no Star is confirmed, remove Star language from Oliver Restaurant structured data on the official dining page.
If approved, present the MICHELIN Key only as hotel-level recognition — never as a Star substitute on the restaurant node.
Archive before/after evidence of the live structured data.
actions.suggestedTimeframe: Within 2–3 weeks of hotel Key confirmation

affectedUrls.label: Michelin Guide hotel listing — One MICHELIN Key

actions.verifiedObservation: Official dining content claims a Michelin Star for Oliver Restaurant. Michelin Guide evidence confirms a MICHELIN Key for the hotel. No independent Michelin restaurant-Star listing for Oliver Restaurant was verified in this research pass.
actions.commercialRationale: Publishing unverified Star language creates reputation risk if guests or partners check Michelin. Confirming Star status before editing protects accuracy without treating Key recognition as Star disproof.
recommendedSteps: Check Michelin Guide restaurant listings for Oliver Restaurant independently of the hotel Key page.
Ask hotel leadership to confirm current Star and Key status in writing.
If no Star is confirmed, remove Star language from Oliver Restaurant structured data on the official dining page.
If approved, present the MICHELIN Key only as hotel-level recognition — never as a Star substitute on the restaurant node.
Archive before/after evidence of the live structured data.
actions.desiredOutcome: Award language retained or corrected only after independent Michelin Star verification; Key presented accurately at hotel level.

evidenceRefs.label: Michelin Guide hotel listing — One MICHELIN Key
